question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

Those who have __________ (humility) will definitely fall down.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Pride.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Humility" means having a modest or low view of one's importance.**(विनम्रता)

 
 
• Example: He needs the humility to accept that their way may be better.
 
 
 
• **The antonym of humility is pride, which means having a high or arrogant view of one's importance.**(गर्व)
 
 
• Example: I take a great pride in my culture.
 
 
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the use of 'definitely fall down' suggests that having pride will lead to failure or downfall.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Weakness is not the opposite of humility. It means lacking strength or being vulnerable.(कमजोरी)
 
• Disrespect means showing a lack of respect or rudeness towards someone or something.(अनादर)
 
• Veracity means truthfulness or accuracy in something.(सच्चाई)
